item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's two simple pendulums in the lab. Both have the same string length at the same place. Pendulum P has a wooden-bead bob. Pendulum Q has a metal-nut bob. He sets both swinging with small oscillations.

Which statement about their time periods is correct?

options.A: P and Q have the same time period, because time period depends on length, not on the mass of the bob.
options.B: Q has a longer time period, because time period depends on the mass of the bob, not on length.
options.C: P and Q have the same time period at every place on Earth, because length alone fixes the time period everywhere.
options.D: Any two periodically moving objects of this length have the same time period at this place.
